question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing right winger, Claire is playing left midfielder, Dave is playing left winger, and Eve is playing sweeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Claire trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Eve and Alice trade positions. Finally, Bob and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) right winger
(C) left midfielder
(D) left winger
(E) sweeper
solution:
Player order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve
Initial: right back | right winger | left midfielder | left winger | sweeper
1. Dave ↔ Claire: right back | right winger | left winger | left midfielder | sweeper
2. Bob ↔ Claire: right back | left winger | right winger | left midfielder | sweeper
3. Claire ↔ Dave: right back | left winger | left midfielder | right winger | sweeper
4. Eve ↔ Alice: sweeper | left winger | left midfielder | right winger | right back
5. Bob ↔ Claire: sweeper | left midfielder | left winger | right winger | right back
Bob plays left midfielder, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
